Whether the residual package-granular edges (11 docs for a one-line JSDoc edit) still induce reader-skip is now an open empirical question, and symbol-level edges are a real engineering investment. Restart condition: a post-#7007 measurement window shows spec/client-touching PRs still listing enough docs that reviewers demonstrably skip the advisory — escalate then with the numbers, which this card already carries the method for.
